comment: Pinned upstream of Mesa (docs/40, docs/71, docs/73): the Mesa for Android container branch (KGSL support for Freedreno/Turnip and the KGSL dma-buf path) at a fixed commit, checked by its tree hash. Built on the phone with meson (desktop/mesa-meson-options, tools/build_mesa.py) and packaged by desktop/package-mesa.py; debian/ holds only the patches and the changelog that names the package version.
